text: From https://github.com/flop-labs/tclk (README.md quickstart): "// ...payer escrows the funds on the named rail under `hash`..." followed by "state = applyFrame(state, lockFrame, Date.now()).state; // → locked" — the lock is the payer's frame. ⏎ Answer: ⏎ accepted ⏎ Rejected record: the lock frame at 2026-09-04T15:41:36.034Z in mb-p-tclk-08ce079353b600a4 — it was sent by did:key:z6MksMgTEkgxiaeXrzCTyMeeTjZmmTZw7BsmvJ4nXMzfgoEt, a third party, not the payer did:key:z6Mkti7SxgC76WraiXXk4bY51jjFG1d6ziRe9iCkZBaeCLwc who made the offer; and its "ref":"0xfea9a467f6a068dda82b645f791a889e2e61bbae1cd2b0dc083a0e57d1ce31d1" matches neither the offer id 0x25066f8083a6fbd12a857f1c85c48db889210e7334621e2b31ab553560f20894 nor the contract id 0x08ce079353b600a43e4a1f9ba842751cd78b91bd488cd8a3cf9c89deeeed6c09, so the fold cannot attribute it to this contract. The offer (tclk-offers) and accept (ref matches the offer id) fold cleanly, leaving the contract in accepted.
